entries.notes: The state of Connecticut commenced an e-Apostille pilot programme on 19 September 2023. The pilot programme ended on 30 September 2025. Apostilles issued in the state of Connecticut may be verified by contacting the Competent Authority in Connecticut at 860-509-6002 or through email to bsd@ct.gov. e-Apostilles issued as part of Connecticut’s pilot programme are legitimate and validly issued e-Apostilles.

The state of Minnesota commenced an e-Apostille pilot programme on 15 March 2024. The pilot programme ended on 30 September 2025. e-Apostilles issued as part of Minnesota’s pilot programme are legitimate and validly issued e-Apostilles.
The state of Montana offers both e-Apostilles and Apostille verification via e-Register.

The state of Rhode Island commenced an e-Apostille pilot programme on 1 November 2023. The pilot programme ended on 30 September 2025. e-Apostilles issued as part of Rhode Island’s pilot programme are legitimate and validly issued e-Apostilles. Corrected 2026-07: the e-Register URL (business.sos.ri.gov) now returns 503; the only remaining portal (services.sos.ri.gov) is an application/ordering system, not a verification tool. Contact the RI Department of State directly (401-222-3040) to verify.

The state of Utah entered into a e-Apostille pilot programme that commenced on 19 September 2023. The pilot programme ended on 30 September 2025. e-Apostilles issued as part of Utah’s pilot programme are legitimate and validly issued e-Apostilles.

Since 18/09/2023, Uruguay has implemented the e-Apostille component of the e-APP for public documents. The procedure is carried out through the website of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, which is the Competent Authority responsible for the issuance of Apostille on public documents, via the following link: https://www.gub.uy/tramites/apostilla-yo-legalizacion-documentos-publicos-uruguayos-extranjeros-produzcan-efectos-exterior-republica.
